description: This file defines the TextResponse class, a specific type of HTTP response that represents plain text responses. It extends a base Response class and provides methods to create a response with a text body, default status code 200, and Content-Type header 'text/plain'. It includes logic to handle string or stream input for the response body, throwing exceptions if invalid input is provided.

classes.name: TextResponse
classes.description: Represents a plain text HTTP response, allowing setting of body, headers, and status code. Handles text or stream input for body content and defaults to 'text/plain' content type with status 200.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new TextResponse with given text or stream, status code, and headers. Creates the message body and injects the Content-Type header.

methods.name: createBody
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface object from the provided text or stream. Throws an exception if the input is invalid (neither string nor stream).
